Semiont source revision: ddd58cb4673e06a022955d9041f261fb816a849f

The xynaut source was extracted from this published monorepo revision. The
protocol specifications, service image recipes, image tag script, service
publication workflow, and Desktop Control API schema in this repository are
reference fixtures from that revision. They are not xynaut's build or release
workflows. Update them deliberately when the Semiont contracts change.

The Semiont Go SDK remains an external dependency pinned in go.mod; the SDK
source is not copied into this repository.
